notes: 2018_01 is the Faculty Handbook; 2018_03 the P&T Manual; 2018_04 the HR FMLA page; 2018_05 BOR 8.2; 2018_06 BOR 8.3; 2018_07 HRAP FMLA; 2018_08 HRAP Sick Leave; 2018_09 the Employee Handbook. 2018_02 is a copy of 2018_09.

Governing documents for faculty leave are present: the GSU Faculty Handbook (leaves and absences), USG Board of Regents Policy 8.2.7 (leave) and 8.3.7 (tenure), and the GSU P&T Manual; missing = false.

No paid parental, maternity or childbirth leave, and no modified duties, exist in any saved source for 2018-02-22. Pregnancy is handled as any other disability through the employee's own accrued sick leave (c2), FMLA (c1), discretionary sick leave without pay (c3) and optional disability insurance (c6, c7).
Reference date 2018-02-22. Documents dated 2017-07 to 2018-03 captures; BOR 8.2 capture is 2018-07-11 but cites no change after May 2015 (version note).

Employee handbook: the Faculty Handbook calls it the staff handbook; the version note says to use it where it applies to faculty and adds to the Faculty Handbook and Regents policy. Its benefits section names 'regular faculty or staff' positions, so its disability insurance (307), FMLA (406), Maternity Leave (408) and lactation (408.1) provisions are coded main_campus_tenure_stream; its sick-leave and personal-leave sections restate BOR policy.
Faculty Handbook calendar: semester system, semesters 'not to be less than 15 calendar weeks'; recorded as calendar.term_weeks 15 (a stated minimum length). No component uses term units.

Birth-parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks from the birth, with the own accrued sick-leave balance applied concurrently (c2 concurrent_with c1) -> discretionary sick leave without pay up to 1 year after balances are exhausted (c3 consecutive_after c2) -> (general-purpose personal leave c4 after FMLA); all leaves combined capped at 12 months (leave_limits 52). Optional employee-paid STD (c6) pays 60% from week 3 (concurrent_with c1, offset 2); shared sick leave (c5) after own balances.

Non-birth-parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks for bonding or care of the spouse, with sick-leave balance concurrently (c2, family illness) -> general-purpose personal leave (c4, not counted); leaves combined capped at 12 months.

Tenure clock: BOR 8.3.7.4 suspension during a birth/adoption leave (c9) and the GSU P&T Manual's maximum two-year suspension (c10) are linked concurrent_with (V3c); the general two-year interruption for any leave (c11) is general_purpose.

Not components: professional leave (scholarly purpose), educational leave (degree study), education support leave (school events), death in the family, court duty, voting, military leave, organ donation, administrative and mandated leave, university closing.
USG HRAP FMLA notes that an institution 'may provide' an institutionally sponsored short-term disability programme; GSU's employee handbook 307 describes its disability insurance (c6, c7).

Cross-references not saved: GSU FMLA Policy; GSU Tenure Clock Stoppage policy; USG Faculty Request for Extension of Probationary Period due to Family Medical Event form; USG Policy on Shared Sick Leave and the GSU Shared Sick Leave Program website; GSU ADA Employee Accommodation Policy; GSU Faculty Workload Policy; USG Academic & Student Affairs Handbook; USG HRAP Sick Leave without Pay and Shared Sick Leave pages; GSU Voluntary Benefit Plans page and benefits plan documents (disability plan terms, premiums and benefit duration).
